title: Onboarding telemetry sprite: compact latency / cost / trace tiles
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design compact telemetry tiles for the onboarding quickstart flow. Goal: provide new users a lightweight snapshot (sprite) of runtime health: median latency, p95 latency distribution, cost-per-token sparkline, recent trace waterfall sample, and a single-line suggestion for tuning (e.g., batch size or KV caching). These assets will be used in docs, in-product onboarding modals, and the Quickstart email. Focus on legibility at 280x160 px thumbnails and an expanded 720x420 px slide for the tour. Avoid duplicating existing observability gallery — create a fresh visual language using condensed data rows, compact micro-sparklines, and a single CTA to "Open full telemetry".
design_tasks: Create 3 size variants: thumbnail (280x160), inline card (360x220), expanded slide (720x420)
Generate SVG micro-sparklines for cost/token and latency distribution
Export accessible color tokens and annotate contrast ratios
Prepare .png/.svg exports for docs and product use
screenshot_specs: Inline card: 360x220, SVG for in-console use, fallback PNG for email
Expanded slide: 720x420, PNG with callout overlays for tour
assets_needed: Live sample data from ENG (latency and cost time-series for 1000 requests)
Canonical trace waterfall (sanitized) for trace panel
Logo / icon set (16px, 24px) for card header
review_notes: PM feedback: surface a single tuning suggestion based on highest-cost signal (batching or quantization)
Eng feedback: ensure sparkline data matches 'console-telemetry/v1' API output; request mock endpoint for stable fixtures
